body:
It's not a good kit and that's sad the fact it's a donor kit. So I have have 3 options that can balance it.

1.Give it a diamond sword

OR

2.Make the time span between using the invisibility dust shorter

OR

3.Make the invisibility time 10 seconds per invisibility dust
